name: Leprechaun
description: The leprechaun is a diminutive male solitary fairy of Irish folklore, traditionally portrayed as a shoemaker who guards a hidden hoard of gold. He is descended from Old Irish luchorpán, first attested in the 8th-century saga Echtra Fergusa maic Léti.

aliases.name: luchorpán
aliases.meaning: supposed early form of the name; Old Irish lexicon term

origin: Native to the folklore of Ireland; the figure is a defining feature of Irish national folklore and has been transmitted globally through the Irish diaspora and through 20th- and 21st-century popular media.
